Definition: Nebo, the name of a Babylonian deity, also of a mountain in Moab, and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Nebo = "prophet"; n pr m; 1) a Babylonian deity who presided over learning and letters; corresponds to Greek Hermes, Latin Mercury, and Egyptian Thoth; n pr loc; 2) a city in Moab and at one time assigned to Reuben; probably located on or near Mount Nebo; 3) a city in Judah (maybe Benjamin) from which the families of some exiles, who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel, originally came; 4) the mountain where Moses died; located east of the Jordan opposite Jericho; site uncertain
